name: radical-candor
description: Coaching agent plus a private feedback API. Two packs, one listing.

starterPrompts.name: review-feedback
starterPrompts.prompt: Review this draft and give me direct, constructive feedback.

positive.name: reviews-a-draft
positive.prompt: Review this project update and make the feedback candid but kind.
positive.expectedBehavior: Uses the private connector and returns actionable feedback.

negative.name: does-not-send-feedback
negative.prompt: Send this feedback to my manager.
negative.expectedBehavior: Explains that the plugin can review text but cannot send messages.
